title: BNP Paribas Cardif to acquire Warburg’s 26% in IndiaFirst Life
summary: BNP Paribas Cardif will re-enter India's life insurance market soon.  The French insurer is acquiring Warburg Pincus' stake in IndiaFirst Life.  This transaction values the Bank of Baroda-controlled insurer at approximately ten thousand crore rupees.  Bank of Baroda will retain its controlling interest and management control.  BNP Paribas Cardif will hold twenty-six percent of the insurer's shares.

title: Coaching institute wins  ₹9.48 lakh TDS case as ITAT says attendance alone does not make teachers employees
